title: Clean bounded-time input copy
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, let $D$ be the release-wrapped three-state input copier described by the machine construction. There is a time $t$ with $0<t\le 2|x|+3$ such that $D$ has not halted at any time $j<t$, and at time $t$ it is halted in the configuration whose tape zero stores $x$, whose other work tapes are blank, whose input head and work-tape heads are at their initial positions, and whose output is empty.
hypotheses_covered: $D$ is the specified release-wrapped input copier, with one work tape
replaced: For every input word $x$, the release-wrapped native input copier, started over the blank state word, first halts at a positive time at most $2|x| + 3$ at the canonical seam whose stored word is exactly $x$, with silent output and unchanged heads.
